verdict.rationale: E2B documents a per-sandbox timeout that can be changed while running via `setTimeout`/`set_timeout`. The docs also say you can `kill` a sandbox before the timeout is up, which implies automatic shutdown when the timeout expires. Hard session caps (24h Pro / 1h Base) and CLI shutdown commands reinforce the lifecycle controls. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that billing stops at timeout, idle-based (activity-aware) auto-shutdown rather than wall-clock timeout, documentation of setting the timeout at creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
